name: Expedition Mess Tent
visual_identity: Large, heavy-duty khaki canvas marquee with reinforced black zippers; open side-flaps revealing a communal interior; features three long wooden trestle tables with industrial orange folding chairs; a small corner kitchenette with a silver percolator and stack of orange melamine plates.
notes: Canvas texture should show subtle weathering and dust accumulation to match the field research pickup truck.
